firms.name: Shark Funded
firms.offerDetails: The referenced offer lists code TFC for Shark Funded challenges. Eligibility and discount vary by account model; confirm the live checkout terms before buying.
firms.summary: A multi-model evaluation firm with MT5 and Match-Trader access. Compare drawdown and payout conditions by model rather than relying on the headline discount.

firms.name: The5ers
firms.offerDetails: The5ers publishes several evaluation and growth programmes. Drawdown, leverage and scaling terms are programme-specific, so validate the rules for your selected account.
firms.summary: An established forex funding brand known for multiple growth paths. Its scaling potential is useful only when the chosen programme’s risk limits fit your strategy.

firms.name: E8 Markets
firms.offerDetails: The reference directory lists E8 Markets offers and model-specific discounts. Check the eligible account type, current code and any regional restrictions on the official checkout.
firms.summary: A multi-platform firm with configurable evaluation routes. Its appeal is flexibility; the key comparison is how each route handles daily and maximum loss.

firms.name: FundingPips
firms.offerDetails: The source offer page lists FundingPips promotions of up to 25% off selected challenges. The final discount depends on the active campaign and challenge model.
firms.summary: A high-recognition evaluation firm with several payout cycles and platforms. Compare its consistency requirements alongside the advertised drawdown.

firms.name: Atlas Funded
firms.offerDetails: Atlas Funded runs multiple account programmes with different drawdown and payout conditions. Verify the selected programme directly before checkout.
firms.summary: A flexible prop-firm option spanning evaluation and instant models. Rules differ materially between models, making side-by-side comparison especially useful.

firms.name: Funded Trader Markets
firms.offerDetails: The referenced listing shows code TRUSTED for 10% off eligible challenges and mentions purchase rewards. Confirm whether rewards and discounts can be combined.
firms.summary: A Dubai-based funding firm with evaluation and instant options. Account-size and model selection can change leverage, drawdown and reward rates.

firms.name: AquaFunded
firms.offerDetails: The reference offer directory lists code TFC for 25% off AquaFunded challenges and a spend-based bonus campaign. Bonus eligibility requires checking current terms.
firms.summary: A multi-platform firm with several evaluation formats. Compare the actual loss model and consistency conditions before weighing any promotional incentive.

firms.name: Alpine Funded
firms.offerDetails: Alpine Funded’s source listing distinguishes Standard and Swing leverage and references programme-specific rules. Check which account family you are comparing.
firms.summary: A scaling-oriented firm with Standard and Swing variations. Leverage and drawdown need to be read together to understand the practical risk budget.

firms.name: Funding Traders
firms.offerDetails: Funding Traders offers multiple models, including instant funding. Profit split and drawdown vary by account, so confirm current model rules before purchase.
firms.summary: A multi-model firm with a broad advertised profit-split range. The useful comparison is the starting split and its upgrade conditions, not only the maximum.

firms.name: FundedNext
firms.offerDetails: The source firm listing shows code TFC and a 10% promotional offer with purchase rewards on eligible accounts. Current campaign terms should be checked at checkout.
firms.summary: A large global funding brand with several Stellar models and broad platform support. Scaling and maximum allocation are not the same as starting account size.

firms.name: Funded Trading Plus
firms.offerDetails: The reference listing shows code TFC for an exclusive 10% discount and purchase rewards. Weekend holding and copy-trading rules vary by programme.
firms.summary: An established UK firm with a wide programme range. Its Master and Advanced programmes can differ on weekend holding and strategy permissions.

firms.name: Tradeify
firms.offerDetails: Tradeify focuses on CME futures funding, with account types that use end-of-day trailing drawdown. Promotions are time-sensitive; verify the active campaign directly.
firms.summary: A futures-specific funding provider with CME market access. Contract limits and trailing-drawdown mechanics matter more here than forex-style leverage comparisons.
